scope: Disposition of legacy Ruby facade and native module methods; not a typed API baseline or a parity claim.

groups.replacement: Typed analyze and diff2 operations in structuredmerge-core, using TreeHaver and Rust-owned family analysis/matching.
groups.gap: parse_sources is syntax transport, not analysis. Ruby currently computes diff2 from owner maps; that semantic implementation must move to Rust, not survive in a renamed adapter.

groups.replacement: Typed directional merge2 and base-aware merge3 request/result envelopes calling the existing family kernels.
groups.gap: The Python declaration and YAML mapping profiles do not replace these families. Preserve current/incoming direction, dialects, conflicts, diagnostics and source evidence; do not synthesize a base for merge2.

groups.replacement: Typed Git merge3 report over ast-merge-git and shared core operation results.
groups.gap: Retain change classifications, render report, conflicted source and exit-policy evidence. The Ruby adapter advertises all operations but rejects analyze/diff2/merge2: capability correction is required, not invented implementations.

groups.replacement: Typed ast-crispr profile reports and explicit byte-range edit requests/results exported from structuredmerge-core.
groups.gap: apply_explicit_source_edits now provides the typed explicit-edit primitive over ast-merge, verified through installed Ruby/Python artifacts. Ruby consumer migration and typed profile reports remain open. Explicit edits do not prove structural selection parity; preserve Ruby selection until separately verified.

groups.replacement: Typed options/profile/plan reports from ast-template through structuredmerge-core.
groups.gap: Report generation is not template execution or filesystem apply. Preserve Ruby apply behavior and downstream kettle-jem gates.

groups.replacement: Typed ParserHost registration, TreeHaver selection and parse_sources; explicit Rust TSLP provider registration and typed normalized results.
groups.gap: Native callback slices exist but the legacy normalized TSLP consumer is not migrated. Replace/list/probe/bulk-clear policies need explicit contracts; matching method names are not drop-in compatibility.

groups.replacement: Typed capability manifest and provider identity with observable availability, support and default authority.
groups.gap: native_merge_profiles is static scope introspection, not registry negotiation or a full manifest.

groups.replacement: Typed WorkflowHost coarse callbacks with explicit host-owned workflow boundaries; Rust retains merge semantics.
groups.gap: No typed WorkflowHost currently exported. Retain boundary regressions, not a separately released host product. Consumer discovery beyond the listed local evidence remains open.

groups.replacement: Real typed-operation lifecycle tests, OperationControl and generated runtime-affine callback infrastructure; no identity-worker product API by default.
groups.gap: Some GC, concurrency, cancellation and deadline cases are migrated. Shutdown, foreign-thread entry and broad stress remain open; do not remove legacy evidence before equivalent coverage.
